haul_supplies_veyra.title: Supply Run to Veyra Reach
haul_supplies_veyra.description: Transport medical supplies to the independent settlements at Veyra Reach. Pay's decent, route's not too dangerous.

haul_parts_ashfall.title: Equipment Delivery to Ashfall
haul_parts_ashfall.description: A mining operation on Ashfall needs drilling equipment. Hazardous route through volcanic debris.

haul_weapons_korrath.title: Arms Shipment to the Front
haul_weapons_korrath.description: The Korrath border needs munitions. Long haul through hostile space. Danger pay included.

bounty_veyra_pirates.title: Clear Pirate Patrols
bounty_veyra_pirates.description: Pirates are disrupting trade in Veyra Reach. Eliminate their patrol ships. The Frontier Council is offering a bounty.

bounty_ghost_nebula.title: Ghost Nebula Sweep
bounty_ghost_nebula.description: Something's controlling the hostiles in the Ghost Nebula. Thin their numbers so our scouts can investigate.
bounty_ghost_nebula.reward_text: 600 credits, 1x Sensor Mk2, 1x Shield Gen Mk2

patrol_ashfall.title: Ashfall Security Patrol
patrol_ashfall.description: The mining colonies need protection. Patrol Ashfall Drift and neutralize hostiles.

salvage_ghost_data.title: Recover Black Box Data
salvage_ghost_data.description: One of our survey ships went down in the Ghost Nebula. We need the black box data -- fly there and scan for the wreck.

salvage_deep_probe.title: Retrieve Deep Space Probe
salvage_deep_probe.description: An unmanned probe was sent into The Deep. It stopped transmitting. If you can find it, the data would be invaluable.

haul_refugees_veyra.title: Refugee Transport
haul_refugees_veyra.description: Displaced settlers need passage to Veyra Reach. They don't have much, but they'll share what tech they saved.

haul_research_deep.title: Research Materials to The Deep
haul_research_deep.description: Scientists need exotic materials transported to a research outpost near The Deep. Extremely dangerous route.
